search.description: Living Evidence Map salmon farming search in CAB Abstracts.
search.search_string: (salmon OR salmonid* OR Salmo OR Oncorhynchus OR "rainbow trout") AND (farm* OR cage* OR pens OR penned OR pen OR aquacultur* OR commercial*)
search.notes: No other restrictions. Exact result total is to be verified from the complete RIS files in the Zenodo draft during W00 validation; user reports more than 25,000 hits.
